subject.title: improve: show search results in a sidebar

question: Should ClickClack adopt this shared right-pane search model, where opening a thread, profile, or artifact intentionally replaces or covers the search panel?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but the permanent ownership and handoff semantics of the app's only right-side workspace are a product interaction choice rather than a correctness question.

options.title: Approve shared-pane search
options.body: Accept the proposed Slack/Discord-style sidebar and its intentional handoff to thread, profile, and artifact surfaces after the branch is rebased and revalidated.

options.title: Keep search independent
options.body: Request a revised design that preserves search alongside other right-pane surfaces or restores it automatically after those surfaces close.

recommendation.title: Approve shared-pane search
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed Slack/Discord-style sidebar and its intentional handoff to thread, profile, and artifact surfaces after the branch is rebased and revalidated.
